owner_decisions: Owner popups 2026-09-30 (recorded in PR #541, docs/governance/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-09-30.md): 'Allowlisted snapshot (Recommended)'; 'Broad (non-sensitive)'; owner review of the first live dry run 2026-10-02 (Inspector 0.2.0, 1491 ids; docs/governance/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-01.md): street-name and car-status sensors 'Keep them'; personal names 'Share with neutral labels' (owner_name_aliases); rest 'Approve the rest (Recommended)'; health-bridge prefix 'Reserve and block it now (Recommended)' (2026-10-02; owner_deny_prefixes sensor.hb_health_ and binary_sensor.hb_health_); Owner pop-up 2026-10-13 'Both (Recommended)' (Cooling chat): history_list adds house RH, outdoor temperature, outdoor dew point and Vent Start OK
notes: friendly_name is never exported: person or place names in names cannot be detected reliably.
Excluded entity ids are never reported; the dry-run report carries only per-reason counts and the ids that would be exported.
Every change to this file is an owner-reviewed repository change; owner_deny_* always wins.

owner_name_aliases: personal names are replaced by neutral labels in the exported copy only (entity ids, state and attribute text, history); an exported id that still contains a name word is excluded (NAME_ALIAS_INCOMPLETE). 'ledger' alone is not a name form (sensor.house_brain_learning_memory_ledger).

owner_deny_prefixes: sensor.hb_health_ and binary_sensor.hb_health_ are reserved for the future #56 health bridge and never exported, whatever their content (owner decision 2026-10-02). The builder refuses a policy that claims health_bridge_prefix_in_owner_deny_prefixes without both prefixes (POLICY_HEALTH_PREFIX_NOT_DENIED).
token_exemptions_rationale: Cooling Arbiter evap pump pulse advice: 'pulse' is a #60 HEALTH token, but these are pump-control advisories, not human health data. Owner-reviewable.
